verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or a 'try it' explorer with runnable examples. The docs only say the APIs are standard REST (oracle-cloud-docs-5) and that SDKs ship code samples (oracle-cloud-docs-4), and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec at any candidate path. Cloud Shell's preconfigured CLI is a runnable environment, but it is not an API reference, so it does not deliver this story.
